name: Emissary Talents
body:
The following are the talents an emissary can learn. A talent can only be acquired once, unless otherwise stated.

Affable Mark (Su)

You can apply your empire’s mark to a target on which you successfully use Bluff or Diplomacy.

Agonizing Emergency (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): farcical agony.

If you successfully use your farcical agony ability, you can make a free feint attempt on 1 creature per 4 levels (minimum 1). Roll the feint attempt once and compare it against all targets. The one dealing the damage that was negated by farcical agony must be one of the targets.

Agonizing Imposition (Su)

As a standard action, you can send an agonizing mental shock through the empire’s mark. All creatures bearing your empire’s mark take nonlethal damage equal to the damage bonus provided by your empire’s mark. This damage does not expend the mark. This is a mind-affecting, pain effect.

Ambassador’s Sense (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): voyaging purpose (envoy’s purpose), Knowledge (arcana) 1 rank.

You gain the ability to cast detect magic at will and you gain a +1 competence bonus on Sense Motive checks.

Animal Mascot (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): animal sidekick.

Your familiar becomes an animal companion as per the ranger’s hunter’s bond option. Your effective druid level for this ability is equal to your emissary level – 3.

Animal Sidekick (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Emissary 3rd.

You gain a familiar as per the wizard’s arcane bond option. Your effective wizard level for this ability is equal to your emissary level. The familiar does not gain the ability to share spells or deliver touch spells.

Astute Evaluation (Ex)

When applying your empire’s mark, you gain a bonus equal to your class level on Knowledge checks to recall information about the target made in the same round. Additionally, you are considered trained for that Knowledge check.

Catspaw Attack (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Improved Trip.

If you hit a creature with a melee attack, you get an automatic trip attempt. You only get one such attempt per round.

Certain Pugilism (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): voyaging purpose (bruiser’s purpose).

Your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 lethal damage and do not provoke attacks of opportunity to use.

Compound Mark (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): dual mark.

You can apply multiple empire’s marks to a single target. However, only one can trigger from a single triggering action.

Dangersense (Ex)

You gain a bonus on Reflex saves and AC against traps and on Perception checks to avoid being surprised by a foe. The bonuses to AC and Reflex are lost if you lose your Dex bonus to AC. The bonus is equal to 1/3 your class level, minimum +1.

Directive to Kneel (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Intimidate 5 ranks

As a standard action, you can make an Intimidate check to demoralize a target. On a success, in addition to the shaken condition, the Intimidate check result is used as a trip attempt that does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

The target must be within 30 feet to be affected.

Echoing Overload (Su)

Prerequisite(s): dual mark.

As a swift action you may apply an overloaded mark on a target within 30 feet. You must be able to place an overloaded mark to use this ability.

Elegant Arming (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): elegant posture.

You gain an additional use of emissary’s grace and you can use it to gain the benefits of Quickdraw for 1 round.

Additionally, if you use Quickdraw, you can make a disarm attempt as your first attack without provoking an attack of opportunity using your Charisma modifier in place of your Strength or Dexterity on the combat maneuver check.

Elegant Posture (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): emissary’s grace.

You gain an additional use of emissary’s grace and you can use it to add your Charisma bonus to your weapon attack and damage rolls for 1 round instead of Strength or Dexterity. The weapon used must be a weapon tied to your imperial origin to gain the benefit.

Farcical Agony (Ex)

If you are hit by an attack, but not a critical hit, as an immediate action you can drop prone and make a Bluff check. If the Bluff check exceeds the attack roll, the damage is negated.

The triggering creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours regardless of the result.

Fall Before Me (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): directive to kneel, Intimidate 10 ranks

You can use your directive to kneel ability as a swift action.

Greater Animal Sidekick (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Animal sidekick, emissary 5th.

You gain an animal companion as per the 5 ranger’s hunter’s bond option. Your effective druid level for this ability is equal to your emissary level -3. This replaces the familiar you gained from animal sidekick.

Honest Brutality (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Diplomacy 5 ranks

As a standard action, you can make a Diplomacy check against a DC of 10 + 1/2 the target’s HD + their Wisdom modifier. The target must bear your empire’s mark. If you succeed, the target is staggered for 1 round. If you exceed the DC result by 10 or more, they are stunned instead. This is a mind-affecting effect.

Honeyed Imposition (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Diplomacy 5 ranks

As a standard action, you can make a Diplomacy check against a DC of 10 + 1/2 the target’s HD + their Wisdom modifier. The target must bear your empire’s mark.

If you succeed, the target takes a -2 penalty to their attack rolls, save DCs, and damage rolls 1 round. If you exceed the DC by 10 or more, they are unable to take an offensive action without succeeding at a Will save DC (10 + 1/2 your class level + your Cha modifier). This is a mind-affecting effect.

Into the Corner (Su)

Prerequisite(s): prod along

If you succeed in using your prod along ability, the target is automatically subject to your empire’s mark, if you so choose, and they are flat-footed against the next attack against them made before the beginning of the next round.

Minor Magic (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): Intelligence 10.

You gain the ability to cast a 0-level spell from the sorcerer/wizard spell list. This spell can be cast three times a day as a spell-like ability. The caster level for this ability is equal to your class level. The save DC for this spell is 10 + your Intelligence modifier.

Major Magic (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): Intelligence 11, minor magic.

You gain the ability to cast a 1st-level spell from the sorcerer/wizard spell list. This spell can be cast two times a day as a spell-like ability. The caster level for this ability is equal to your class level. The save DC for this spell is 11 + your Intelligence modifier.

Many Ports Dabbler (Ex)

You have been to many places and learned an eclectic set of skills. You gain the Signature Skill feat in one of the following, so long as you have 5 ranks in the skill: Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, Knowledge, Linguistics, Performance, and Sense Motive. You may gain this ability multiple times, choosing a different Signature Skill feat each time.

Painful Mark (Su)

Prerequisite(s): Intimidate 5 ranks

You can attempt an Intimidate check as a swift action to increase the pain dealt by your empire’s mark. If your check succeeds against a DC of 10 + 1/2 the target’s HD + their Wisdom modifier, the target is sickened for 1d4 rounds in addition to the damage dealt when the mark is expended. You may attempt this Intimidate check anytime while the mark is active, but the mark can only be empowered once.

Prod Along (Ex)

As a standard action, you can make an Intimidate check to demoralize a target. On a success, in addition to the shaken condition, the Intimidate check result is used as a bull rush attempt that does not require you to move.

Rapid Posture (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): elegant posture.

When using elegant posture, you can gain an additional attack at your highest base attack bonus by expending two uses of emissary’s grace. This extra attack does not stack with those from other sources like haste or speed weapons.

Resilience of the Land (Su)

Prerequisite(s): imperial origin (fjords of ice, necromantic hold, or sands of flame).

You gain a resistance to the hostile energy of your imperial home. You gain or increase your resistance to the energy type equal to your level. For fjords of ice, the resistance is cold, for flickering blossom it is positive energy, for necromantic hold and umbral wood it is negative energy, and for sands of flame it is fire.

Soothe-Sing (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): voyaging purpose (voyager’s purpose), Performance 5 ranks.

You can use Performance in place of Heal when making checks for long-term care.

Tigerspaw Pummel (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): catspaw attack.

If you succeed at the trip attack initiated by your catspaw attack, the target takes 1d4 bleed damage.

Trapfinding (Ex)

You add 1/2 your class level on Perception checks to locate traps and on Disable Device checks (minimum +1). You can use Disable Device to disarm magic traps.

Tricky Mark (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): voyaging purpose (scoundrel’s purpose).

You can apply your empire’s mark to a target on which you successfully perform any combat maneuver.

Underhanded Efforts (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): voyaging purpose (scoundrel’s purpose).

You can use Bluff in place of Diplomacy to improve the attitude of a creature. Additionally, you gain a +1 competence bonus to Bluff checks.

Want You Gone (Su)

When your empire’s mark would be expended, you can use an immediate action to maintain it until the next action would expend it. An empire’s mark can only be extended once before it needs to be replaced.
